title: Sunoco LP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Sunoco LP filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, disclosing that its Board of Directors approved a quarterly cash distribution of $0.9899 per common unit ($3.9596 annualized) for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
